primary_objective: Within-receptor, within-assay, within-scaffold mutation direction stability of FoldX Interaction Energy
independence_scope: Unused variants from a previously developed PMI family; optional homologous receptor; not blinded and not training-clean

reference_label.quantity: Kd_nM from SPR competition, separately for MDM2 and MDMX
reference_label.error_sensitivity: Endpoints mean +/- 2 times reported error must retain >=3-fold direction; not a 95% CI when error type/covariance is unknown
reference_label.censoring: Never substitute a bound as a point estimate; admit direction only if the conservative bound proves >=3-fold change; exclude from ordinary Spearman
reference_label.unresolved_error_type: Preserve reported +/- and leave SD/SEM field blank; execution release requires resolution or a versioned, pre-score change of scope

folding.MSA: One common receptor MSA per system, hash and reuse across variants and seeds; record any server use
folding.peptide_MSA: Single sequence; no mutation-dependent peptide homolog search
folding.chain_role: A receptor / B full chemical peptide, verified for each structure

relaxation.method: ColabFold CPU Amber restrained minimization, inherited settings

folding.seed_interpretation: Two stochastic seeds and three parameter models are computational uncertainty samples, not biological replicates

quality_gate.interface_pae_definition: On the uniformly relaxed full-length structure identify receptor residues with any peptide heavy atom within 6 A; take median of both directed PAE blocks between those receptor residues and ALL peptide residues, using original AFM PAE
quality_gate.missing_metrics: Fail quality gate; do not substitute zero
quality_gate.confidence_source: Original AFM confidence is not updated by Amber or RepairPDB

scoring.primary: FoldX RepairPDB then AnalyseComplex A/B Interaction Energy
scoring.units: kcal/mol proxy, not calibrated DeltaG(binding) or DeltaDeltaG
scoring.terminal_flags: Only set noNterm/noCterm and actual atoms after chemical audit; both false only if free termini are confirmed
scoring.graphpep: Optional descriptive structural/contact endpoint only; do not select or promote candidates using it
scoring.deadband_interpretation: Operational tolerance, not an experimental affinity effect size or statistical significance

pairing.per_model_gain: E_parent - E_variant on the same seed and parameter model
pairing.correct_seed_direction: At least 2 matched differences exceed the deadband in the expected direction AND the paired median exceeds that deadband in the same direction
pairing.stable_correct_edge: Correct under BOTH predeclared folding seeds
pairing.tie_or_insufficient_pairs: inconclusive; counts as not correct in the all-prespecified-edge denominator
pairing.cross_seed_pooling: Forbidden as primary decision; do not select the better seed

primary_metric.name: stable_direction_accuracy_by_system
primary_metric.formula: Number of prespecified edges stable-correct in both seeds / all prespecified primary edges
primary_metric.shared_parent_and_reverse_edges: Dependent contrasts, not independent binomial trials; never count both orientations of an edge
primary_metric.within_family_rank: Spearman(proxy, log10(Kd)) per system and seed, secondary/descriptive; report n, coverage and censoring
primary_metric.pooled_correlation: Exploratory only; cannot override any direction failure

failure_policy.no_contact: structural failure, primary direction inconclusive, retained in denominator; numeric energy if emitted only in unfiltered appendix
failure_policy.weak_binder_quality_failure: Same handling as strong binder; failure alone is not evidence of correct weaker affinity
failure_policy.score_or_structure_failure: Keep original logs and reason codes, no zero or favorable artificial penalty
failure_policy.technical_retry: At most one retry for an identified technical failure with identical scientific parameters and seed; preserve first attempt
failure_policy.forbidden_retry: No new seeds, model search, selective relaxation, P27A re-minimization or new scoring parameters to rescue directions
failure_policy.all_generated_results: Report unfiltered coverage and diagnostics alongside quality-filtered primary results

budget.pilot: Base peptide x 2 seeds x 3 parameter models = 6 structures per entered system, included in totals
budget.timing_status: Budget caps, not measured runtime or an ETA; incomplete results stop without seed replacement

enter_prediction: Only after all data-entry checks and pilot runtime inputs are auditable; do not execute historical wrappers with hard-coded old output paths
pilot_stop: Either seed of base peptide has fewer than 2 passing parameter models, budget exceeded, chemistry/sequence mismatch or unresolved technical integrity error
limited_validation_pass: All 4 primary edges stable-correct (4/4) and fully comparable under both seeds; completed input/output audit; no post-score changes
stop_scientific: Any primary direction wrong or inconclusive means limited_validation_pass=false; retain data, no tuning on the same validation set
design_restart_gate: A limited validation pass alone does not authorize general optimization: require a separate un-enriched same-assay loss/gain dataset with new scaffold or explicitly restricted design claim; old P27A continuation_pass=false remains unchanged
forbidden_claims: experimental Kd improvement of new designs
two unrelated systems from homologous MDM2/MDMX assays
